site.context: Dead Sea industrial shore; open-water ion assay, not a concession sample

meta.quality: Majors cited from Wikipedia Dead Sea chemistry (early-1980s surface). Li+ cited as 18 mg/L open-water (Alsabbagh et al. 2021); end-brine 30–40 mg/L is not used.
meta.notes: Ion mass concentrations are g/kg brine as published. Li+ is 0.018 g/L converted with density 1.24 kg/L → 0.018/1.24 ≈ 0.0145 g/kg. mol_per_kg = g_per_kg / molarMassG from engine/model SUBSTANCES. Literature numbers are preferred over forcing charge balance. Headline salinity 276 g/kg is cited context; water mass uses the summed ion masses, not that headline.

lithium.note: Open-water Dead Sea 18 mg/L (Alsabbagh et al. Minerals Engineering 2021). End-brine 30–40 mg/L is not used. Converted with density 1.24 kg/L.
